text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! Claiming a brilliant victory in the
first leg of the Classic Triple Crown is this very Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: I am Biwa Hayahide!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I... didn't lose.
I shouldn't have lost... So why...?!)
(A shiver—)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Her voice, her momentum. The sensation of being completely overwhelmed still lingers in my body...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...*pant*... *gasp*... Aah, dammit!!
Next time for sure... without fail. I'll definitely win...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, Ticket.
To you, too—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...You guys really are amazing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But, but, but, but, but!
The Derby is already up next!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat both of you!!
Because the Derby is...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's my dream! A dream I will never give up on!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
DEEEEERRRBBYYYYYY!!
WOOOOOOOOOOAAAAHHHH--!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk. So losing just fired you up even more?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geez, it's the same on our end, but still...!

Despite her brilliant victory,
Biwa Hayahide's expression remained clouded.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. No.
I'm fine, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm not afraid of anything—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's nothing!
We are steadily moving forward, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's just that there was something I overlooked. That's why I miscalculated regarding Taishin...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Ticket's sheer tenacity to squeeze out every last bit of energy.
And Taishin's terrifyingly fierce late charge."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both possess top-tier finishing bursts.
As expected... of those two.

"...Biwa Hayahide should have done thorough
analysis. So why—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. There's not much time left until the Derby.
If we are to revise our theory, we must do it quickly...
Just as she said, our next goal is the second leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Japanese Derby (Tokyo Yushun).

Yet as her words urged me along,
I couldn't shake the feeling that the gears were slowly grinding out of alignment.
